content.comment_body: Hello all, I've created an agenda system using [product_name] tools (files attached). It allows users to schedule output activation for specific days; days are toggled on the web interface and custom on/off times can be entered in two fields below. Times use a 24-hour 4-digit format, for example: 0915 for 9:15am and 1430 for 2:30pm. However, after inputting these numbers, they're shown with a '16#' prefix in the fields. The scheduling itself works, but I'd like the display to show just the number entered, without the prefix. Is there a way to resolve this?
Hi, The following video demonstrates how to address this issue: [url] BR. [user_name]
Instead of using analog values, scale the time and select the 'Weekly On/Off time' option. See the attachment for details.
Note: The video mainly assists with older web editors [version_no]. In newer web editors [version_no], the updated 'Scale time' function and 'Weekly ON/OFF time' selection offer a solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have noticed that scheduled times entered via the web-based agenda system are shown in hexadecimal format (with '16#' prefix) rather than the original numeric 24-hour input. Although the scheduling works as intended, there is interest in a more straightforward, numeric display. Users highlight that newer software versions provide better options for displaying and handling time values, improving user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the time values they input to appear in the same numeric format on the interface, rather than being automatically converted to hexadecimal. This is to ensure clearer, more user-friendly interaction.
